definitions.name: R1C.MOD
definitions.body: 'MM' BIND 'MX' BIND MX MX MM DIV FLOOR MM MUL SUB
definitions.note: x m R1C.MOD: remainder of x divided by a positive m, as x - m*floor(x/m).

definitions.name: R1C.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'CX' BIND 1 CX 2 DIV CX 3 MUL 1 ADD CX 2 R1C.MOD 0 EQ SELECT CX 1 EQ SELECT
definitions.note: One Collatz step on a positive integer; 1 stays 1.

definitions.name: R1C.USTEP
definitions.body: 'UC' BIND 'UA' BIND UA CHARS -1 DROP JOIN UA UC 2 COLLECT JOIN UA CHARS -1 GET [ ')' ']' '(' '[' ] [ '(' '[' '?' '?' ] RECORD UC GET EQ SELECT
definitions.note: Stack step for bracket reduction: acc String (sentinel '#') and a char; a closer matching the top pops it, anything else is pushed.

definitions.name: R1C.REVENUE
definitions.body: [ 'XR' BIND XR 'qty' GET XR 'price' GET MUL 0 XR 'price' GET NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Orders Vector -> exact total of qty times price over the orders that have a price.

definitions.name: R1C.QTY_BY_SKU
definitions.body: 'XO' BIND XO [ 'XEA' BIND XEA 'sku' GET ] MAP 'XSK' BIND XO [ 'XEB' BIND XEB 'qty' GET ] MAP 'XQT' BIND XSK XQT GROUP 'XGR' BIND XGR KEYS 'XKK' BIND XGR VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP 'XVV' BIND XKK XVV RECORD
definitions.note: Orders Vector -> Record from sku to total qty, skus in first-appearance order.
